title: Bill of Lading
description: Ocean (port-to-port) bill of lading. Container numbers follow ISO 6346 (4 letters + 7 digits incl. check digit).

date_order.description: Order of day/month/year in the dates printed on this document; 'unknown' when no date is printed

decimal_style.description: How decimal numbers are printed on this document: point_decimal (1,234.56) or comma_decimal (1.234,56); 'unknown' when no number reveals it

document_conventions.description: FIRST, before extracting any value: classify the document's printed date and number conventions

bl_number.description: Bill of lading number exactly as printed

booking_number.description: Carrier booking reference; null if not stated

address.description: The party's address block exactly as printed: every address line (street, postal/city, country) verbatim and in printed order. Preserve line breaks as newline characters when the lines are stacked; when the address is printed on a single line, copy that line with its separators as-is. When the only location printed for the party is a country name, that country name IS the address block: copy it here and keep it out of the name field. EXCLUDE labeled non-address lines such as 'VAT: …', 'Tel …' or an email address — those have their own fields

consignee.description: Consignee; for a negotiable B/L the name may be 'TO ORDER' or 'TO ORDER OF SHIPPER' with no address

When the only location printed for the party is a country name, that country name IS the address block: copy it here and keep it out of the name field. notify_party.description: Notify party. MUST be null (not an object) when the box is empty or merely references the consignee, e.g. 'SAME AS CONSIGNEE'

place_of_receipt.description: Place of receipt for combined transport; null if port-to-port only

name.description: Port name exactly as printed, name portion only — from 'ROTTERDAM, NETHERLANDS' copy 'ROTTERDAM'; never reformatted

country.description: Port country — the country exactly as printed (name or code), ONLY when printed; never inferred from an address

name.description: Port name exactly as printed, name portion only — from 'ROTTERDAM, NETHERLANDS' copy 'ROTTERDAM'; never reformatted

country.description: Port country — the country exactly as printed (name or code), ONLY when printed; never inferred from an address

place_of_delivery.description: Final place of delivery; null if port-to-port only

marks_and_numbers.description: Shipping marks and numbers as printed, newline-separated

seal_number.description: Carrier seal number; null when the field shows a placeholder such as 'N/A' or '—'

container_type.description: Container size/type exactly as printed — code ('45G1') or wording ("40' HC")

packages_count.description: Number of packages in this container — exactly as printed, including any spelled-out form

package_kind.description: Kind of packages exactly as printed, e.g. CARTONS

gross_weight_kg.description: Gross weight in kilograms — the number exactly as printed, keeping separators; no units

volume_cbm.description: Measurement in cubic metres — the number exactly as printed, keeping separators; no units

total_packages.description: Total number of packages across all containers — exactly as printed, including any spelled-out form

total_gross_weight_kg.description: Total gross weight in kilograms — the number exactly as printed, keeping separators; no units

total_volume_cbm.description: Total measurement in cubic metres — the number exactly as printed, keeping separators; no units

shipped_on_board_date.description: Shipped-on-board date — the date exactly as printed; do NOT reformat

place_of_issue.description: Place where the B/L was issued

date_of_issue.description: Date of issue — the date exactly as printed; do NOT reformat

number_of_originals.description: Number of original B/Ls issued, e.g. 'THREE (3)' — exactly as printed, including any spelled-out form

iso-6346.description: Container number exactly as printed, including any spaces.

un-locode.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE exactly as printed, ONLY if explicitly printed on the document. Never derive it from a port or place name; emit null when no code is printed.
